## ✅ Checklist Before Review
### General
- [ ] Does the code follow coding standards and best practices?
- [ ] Are variable, function, and class names meaningful?
- [ ] Is the code easy to read and maintain?

### Functionality
- [ ] Does the feature/fix meet the business requirements?
- [ ] Are all possible edge cases handled?
- [ ] Are there any potential bugs or vulnerabilities?

### Performance & Security
- [ ] Are there any performance optimizations applied?
- [ ] Are sensitive data and API keys handled securely?
- [ ] Are proper authentication and authorization checks in place?

### Testing & Documentation
- [ ] Are unit/integration tests added or updated?
- [ ] Do all existing tests pass?
- [ ] Are code comments and documentation updated?
